```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, results = "asis")
results <- params$results
packages <- params$packages
fullname <- params$fullname

get_version <- function(package) {
  tryCatch(as.character(utils::packageVersion(package)), error = function(e) "Not installed")
}
```

\newpage

# Computer information

```{r}
computer_info <- tibble::tibble(
  Item = c(
    "Full name:",
    "User name:",
    "Computer name:",
    "Operating system:",
    "R version:",
    "rxode2 version:",
    "mrgsolve version:",
    "testthat version:",
    "riskmetric version:",
    "campsisqual version:"
  ),
  Value = c(
    fullname,
    Sys.info()[["user"]],
    Sys.info()[["nodename"]],
    get_os_name(),
    paste(R.version$major, R.version$minor, sep = "."),
    get_version("rxode2"),
    get_version("mrgsolve"),
    get_version("testthat"),
    get_version("riskmetric"),
    get_version("campsisqual")
  )
)
kableExtra::kbl(computer_info, format = "latex", col.names = NULL, booktabs = TRUE, linesep = "") |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position", position = "left") |>
  print()
```

# Campsis suite qualification summary

The table below summarises the number of expectations that passed, failed, raised a warning,
raised an error or were skipped, for each tested package of the Campsis suite.

```{r}
print_summary_kable(results$summarised)
```

```{r}
qual_ok <- qualification_passed(results$summarised)
status <- ifelse(
  qual_ok,
  "\\textcolor{teal}{\\textbf{SUCCESSFUL}}",
  "\\textcolor{red}{\\textbf{FAILED}}"
)
cat(sprintf("\n\n\\textbf{Status:} %s on %s\n\n", status, format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")))
cat("The qualification is successful when no test failed and no error occurred.",
    "Warnings and skipped tests are reported for information only.\n\n")
```

```{r}
for (package in packages) {
  pkg_results <- results$all[[package]]

  cat("\\newpage\n\n")
  cat(sprintf("# Package %s (version %s)\n\n", package, as.character(getNamespaceVersion(package))))

  # Package overview (risk metrics)
  cat("## Package overview\n\n")
  assessment <- assess_package(package, successful_tests = qualification_passed(pkg_results))
  categories <- table(factor(assessment$Category, levels = unique(assessment$Category)))
  assessment |>
    dplyr::mutate(Criteria = escape_latex(Criteria), `More info` = format_more_info(`More info`)) |>
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c("Criteria", "Result", "More info"))) |>
    kableExtra::kbl(format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE) |>
    kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position", full_width = FALSE) |>
    kableExtra::column_spec(1, width = "5.2cm") |>
    kableExtra::column_spec(2, width = "1.2cm") |>
    kableExtra::column_spec(3, width = "8.5cm") |>
    kableExtra::pack_rows(index = categories) |>
    print()
  cat("\n\n")

  # Test results by script
  cat("## Test results by script\n\n")
  summarise_results_by_script(pkg_results) |>
    kableExtra::kbl(format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, longtable = TRUE, linesep = "") |>
    kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "repeat_header"), full_width = FALSE) |>
    kableExtra::column_spec(1, width = "6.5cm") |>
    print()
  cat("\n\n")

  # Failed tests and warnings
  cat("## Failed tests and warnings\n\n")
  cat("### Failed tests\n\n")
  failures <- results$failures[[package]]
  if (is.null(failures) || nrow(failures) == 0) {
    cat("No test failed and no error occurred.\n\n")
  } else {
    failures |>
      dplyr::transmute(
        `Test script` = escape_latex(file),
        Test = escape_latex(test),
        Type = type,
        Message = format_message(message)
      ) |>
      kableExtra::kbl(format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, longtable = TRUE, escape = FALSE, linesep = "\\addlinespace") |>
      kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = "repeat_header", full_width = FALSE) |>
      kableExtra::column_spec(1, width = "3cm") |>
      kableExtra::column_spec(2, width = "4cm") |>
      kableExtra::column_spec(3, width = "1.2cm") |>
      kableExtra::column_spec(4, width = "6.5cm") |>
      print()
    cat("\n\n")
  }

  cat("### Warnings\n\n")
  warnings <- results$warnings[[package]]
  if (is.null(warnings) || nrow(warnings) == 0) {
    cat("No warning was raised.\n\n")
  } else {
    warnings |>
      dplyr::transmute(Warning = format_message(warning), Occurrences = occurrences) |>
      kableExtra::kbl(format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, longtable = TRUE, escape = FALSE, linesep = "\\addlinespace") |>
      kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = "repeat_header", full_width = FALSE) |>
      kableExtra::column_spec(1, width = "12.5cm") |>
      print()
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```
